text: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. At the time of application, applicants must hold a valid foreign passport or other valid proof of foreign nationality (Please see: Eligibility Instructions for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants (Nationality Status) 2027). 2 Applicants should be in good physical and mental health, demonstrate goodwill toward China, and hold a valid high school graduation certificate. The high school educational qualification must have been obtained through full-time, in-person education. 3 Academic performance Outstanding academic performance. Proof should be provided by (but not limited to) the following document(s): High school/University (if applicable) transcripts (in Chinese or English). Certificate of National/Regional Graduation Examination/Matriculation Examination (e.g. ATAR/ Abitur/ BAC/ CSAT/ UEC/ STPM/ others). Results of international standardized tests (e.g. CSCA/SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB/others). Award Certificate(s) from international- or national-level Olympiads in mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, informatics, etc. (if applicable). Other Supporting Materials. 3 Language proficiency Applicants must have a high level of English language proficiency. For those with a native language other than English, a test report of English language proficiency will need to be provided (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/others). 4 Aged 18 or above (by September 1, 2027). Applicants under 18 must present Guarantee Statement of Guardian in China and relevant supporting documents at the time of registration. 5 Applicants must meet the requirements outlined in Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China, as well as Eligibility Instructions for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants (Nationality Status) 2027. Applicants who do not meet the above requirements or fail to submit all required materials to the application system in accordance with the Submission Requirements for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027, will be deemed ineligible to apply. Note: All divisions and colleges of Tsinghua University require students to have a strong foundation in mathematics and English; Other High School Subject Required: Physics
